details.s: Ar-Pharazôn, or Tar-Calion, later titled "the Golden", was the twenty-fifth and last King of Númenor. Of all the rulers of Númenor, he wielded the most power, but used it most unwisely; his desire for eternal life which Sauron intentionally and deceptively exploited, caused the Downfall of Númenor and the Change of the World.
f: King of Númenor, "King of Men", "King of the Sea"
Imprisoned in the Caves of the Forgotten in SA 3319
